about.title: About
body: Rentals shows dresses from rental shops in Barwani, so you can see what's there before you visit.
When you like a dress, one tap sends the shop a WhatsApp message. You and the shop agree everything directly.

how-it-works.title: How it works
steps: Tap "Ask on WhatsApp" on the one you like.
Talk to the shop and agree the rent.
body: No account, no payment on this site. It's free for you.

for-shops.title: For shops
body: Show your dresses to everyone in Barwani, free. Customers message you on WhatsApp.
Sign in with Google, confirm your mobile number once, and fill in one short form. We check every shop and usually approve it within a day.
Then add dresses by tapping options and taking photos. No typing needed.

terms.title: Terms
body: Rentals is only a discovery website. We are not a party to any rental or sale.
Prices, availability, deposits and the condition of dresses are set by each shop. Agree everything with the shop directly.
Shops must list only dresses they really have. We remove listings that break this.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: Shoppers don't create accounts and we don't collect their personal data. Saved dresses stay in your own browser.
We count page views and WhatsApp taps per dress, without knowing who you are.
Shop names, addresses and phone numbers are public by design, so customers can contact them. Sellers sign in with Google; we store their email and verified mobile number.
